text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Haru Urara got injured, 
so I quickly took her to the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Thank goodness, they said it's just 
a normal injury!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Teacher had such a scary look on their 
face, I panicked thinking I had some 
illness that needed shots!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Getting shots hurts way worse than this! 
Something like this won't stop me from 
running at aaaaall!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's continue training!
choice_data_list: Take your time, rest up, and get better.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! A day off~~? Why, why? I'm full of 
energy~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see... So you're worried. 
Hmmmmmm!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll take a break! If you're not 
feeling well, Trainer, it makes me sad 
too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll rest up, really rest up... Real 
slow-like............

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm getting so restless! Taking a 
break might be just as tough as getting a 
shot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara seemed a bit bored... but her 
condition steadily improved.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hyee!! ...Wh-Why?
choice_data_list:
If it gets worse, it'll hurt way more than 
a shot.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Yeah, right! There's no way anything 
hurts more than a shot!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! Even if I do this, it's 
totally fine—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hau!! ...O-Oww... It hurts...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making reckless movements aggravated the 
injury, forcing her to rest for several 
days...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? Trainer? Why did you go quiet?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Um... does that mean... er... it's really 
true...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Ugh...!! No way!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Resting is boring and I hate it, but... 
Anything that hurts worse than a 
shot............ is way worse!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get better right away!! 
Absolutely!!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! Once I'm all better, 
I'm gonna run sooo, sooooo much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it took time for the injury to 
heal... she managed to regain her strength 
and spirits.
